card.name: Words in sweeping history and humanity passages
card.fires_on: Small linking words (for, until, to, is, new, nearly) inside general web text about the world, the universe, civilization or history. They come just before a span of time or a grand scale.

modes.label: Spans of time
modes.description: Linking word before a long stretch of years or ages.
modes.example: Explain that it has been around<< for>> thousands of years and has undergone a lot

modes.label: Cosmic or world scale
modes.description: Word leading to the edge of the universe or the end of civilization.
modes.example: Astronomers have looked right<< to>> the edge of the visible universe and even

modes.label: Big-picture human themes
modes.description: Word in talk of vocation, empires, ideologies or civilization.
modes.example: His lessons are everlasting and relevant<< until>> the end of civilization. Martyr M

card.writes: It pushes toward words about humanity, nations and societies, and away from words like weekly and monthly.
card.plain: It lights up on small connecting words in passages about world history, civilization and the universe.
